weno5_grad.reference: Jiang & Shu (1996), JCP 126(1):202-228, eqs. (2.5)-(2.10) and (2.16)-(2.18); Shu (1998) NASA/CR-97-206253 §2.2. MOL PR #531 parity: rules_weno.jl `_weno_template` (pinned SHA 35cc9143dc553ac7d3619738bd77b250c1ed162f).
weno5_grad.notes: WENO5 approximation of grad($u, $x) = ∂u/∂x for positive-velocity advection on a uniform 1D Cartesian grid. Implements the Jiang-Shu (1996) scheme as (hp - hm) / dx where hp is the left-biased reconstruction at face i+1/2 (ideal weights 3/10, 3/5, 1/10) and hm is the right-biased reconstruction at face i-1/2 (ideal weights 1/10, 3/5, 3/10). Both reconstructions use the same 5-cell stencil {u[i-2],...,u[i+2]} and the same smoothness indicators β_k. Added for MOL #531 parity (esd-ubz): the interior WENO5 case in rules_weno.jl fires on Dx(u) (= grad in ESS) not on div(U·q), so weno5_advection.json does not cover this case. No new WENO math — same β_k, ω_k, reconstruction polynomials as weno5_advection.json.
